uiSetup.adaptiveInfoUC: Adaptive Difficulty: The more Imperial groups you manage to defeat, the harder the Empire tries to stop you, but the better your rewards.

uiMainApp.eliteUpgradeMsgUC: One or more <color="green">Regular</color> Deployments have been upgraded to an <color="red">Elite</color> Group.
uiMainApp.eliteDowngradeMsgUC: One or more <color="red">Elite</color> Deployments have been downgraded to a <color="green">Regular</color> Group.
uiMainApp.fame1UC:
If you finish the mission before the end of Round 7, you can claim the number of Awards shown.

After the mission, Awards can be used to:
uiMainApp.fameItem1UC: • Draw an additional Item card from an Item deck of your choice during the Rebel Upgrade stage (cost: 1 Award per card).
uiMainApp.fameItem2UC: • Draw an additional Side Mission card and put it into play as an active mission (cost: 2 Awards per card, maximum 2 cards).
uiMainApp.fame2UC: Once the round counter reaches 8, Mission Awards are set to 0.
uiMainApp.reinforceWarningUC: There are either no Enemy Groups to reinforce, or the current Threat is too low to reinforce any Groups.
uiMainApp.deploymentWarningUC: There are either no Enemy Groups to deploy, or the current Threat is too low to deploy any Groups.
uiMainApp.noRandomMatchesUC: No matching groups with cost {d} or less.

sagaMainApp.noDPWarningUC: WARNING - No Active Deployment Point found.

sagaMainApp.groupsExhaustUC: The following groups have become Exhausted
sagaMainApp.medpacInfoUC:
A hero can use a Medpac when they perform a Rest Action, and an Ally figure can use a Medpac as an Action.

When a figure uses a Medpac, it recovers 5 {H}. Medpacs can be found in Crates.

uiCampaign.threatInfoUC: Threat level is equal to the most recently played mission.
uiCampaign.campaignDescriptionUC: Embark on a new or existing Campaign through the galaxy.
uiCampaign.sagaDescriptionUC: Play a single, narratively driven mission with a 3D map presentation.
uiCampaign.classicDescriptionUC: Play a single mission using your campaign guide and no 3D map.
uiCampaign.agendaImperialUC: The Empire sees you as a threat worth stopping. Draw a card from the Imperial Mission Deck and put it into play. If it is a forced mission, immediately play that mission. If it is a side mission, it becomes an active side mission.
uiCampaign.agendaRebelUC: The Empire uses its resources elsewhere. Nothing happens.

uiTacticalAI.docAggressive: Advance (close into combat - one attack per activation)
uiTacticalAI.docGuard: Guard (hold the zone, never be lured out)
uiTacticalAI.docAmbusher: Ambush (stay unseen until the first shot)
uiTacticalAI.moveFocus: Move {0}: If a hero already stands inside your attack range: hold your ground and ready your fire. Otherwise: if this activation already attacked, back off up to {0} spaces from {1} while keeping him in sight; if it has not attacked yet, close in on {1}
uiTacticalAI.moveFocusNoTarget: Move {0}: If a hero already stands inside your attack range: hold and ready fire. Otherwise: after an attack, back off from the nearest hero; before any attack, close in on it
uiTacticalAI.moveGuard: Move {0}: hold your position inside your guard zone (the mission objective you defend, plus its rim). A hero enters it: face him - but your move ALWAYS ends back inside the guard zone. Never be lured out
uiTacticalAI.moveBlocker: Move {0}: take the field between the mission objective and the nearest hero - his shortest route to the objective must cross your tile. Not reachable: hold the next chokepoint on his route
uiTacticalAI.moveSupport: Move {0}: keep your distance. Already attacked? Back off up to {0} spaces from the nearest hero while keeping him in sight. Not attacked yet: close in on {1} only if no hero would end up in melee reach of you
uiTacticalAI.moveAmbusher: Move {0}: only step onto tiles no hero can see - stay hidden until a target stands inside your range. First hero in range: attack
uiTacticalAI.attackFocus: Have you not attacked yet? Then: {0}, if in range with a clear line. No line / out of range: move up to {1} spaces toward {0}. Line blocked by ANOTHER hero: attack that blocking hero
uiTacticalAI.attackNoTarget: Have you not attacked yet? Then: the nearest hero you can shoot (range + clear line). No access: close in on the nearest hero
uiTacticalAI.attackGuard: Have you not attacked yet? Then: the nearest hero INSIDE your guard zone (range + clear line). None inside but {0} is shootable: {0}. Neither: hold your ground, no shot
uiTacticalAI.attackGuardNoTarget: Have you not attacked yet? Then: the nearest hero inside your guard zone (range + clear line). None inside: hold, no shot
uiTacticalAI.attackAmbush: Have you not attacked yet? Then the ambush shot: the first hero you can shoot from here (range + clear line) - surprise beats target choice, even over {0}. Afterwards: do not unmask further
uiTacticalAI.attackAmbushNoTarget: Have you not attacked yet? Then the ambush shot: the first hero you can shoot from here (range + clear line). Afterwards: stay masked
uiTacticalAI.attackSupport: Have you not attacked yet? Then: {0}, if in range with a clear line - prefer soft targets from cover. No line / out of range: back off instead of pushing in. Line blocked by ANOTHER hero: attack that blocking hero
uiTacticalAI.attackSupportNoTarget: Have you not attacked yet? Then: the softest target you can shoot from cover (range + clear line). No target: back off

uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveGuard: push up to {0} spaces against the nearest hero INSIDE your guard zone, or hold your position
uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveAmbush: relocate to a tile no hero can see (up to {0}) - your next shot comes from new cover
